I've updated the memory.py module to use the `OTHER_MODEL` parameter from the settings file instead of hardcoding the model name. Specifically, I made the following changes:

1. Added the import statement at the top of the file:
   ```python
   from leanworks.rag.setting import OTHER_MODEL
   ```

2. Replaced both instances of hardcoded model names with the `OTHER_MODEL` parameter:
   - In the first call to generate a summary of older memories
   - In the second call to condense combined summaries when needed

Now all model references across the RAG system are using the centralized parameters from the settings file. This makes the codebase more maintainable since any model changes only need to be updated in one place (the settings file) rather than throughout the code.
